description:
Remove an Operator from the DPYC community registry.

Requires the same two proofs as ``register_operator``:

- ``proof`` proves the caller controls the Operator's ``npub``.
- ``authority_proof`` proves the Authority's human admin consents
  to the removal. Without the Authority proof, anyone who knew an
  Operator's public npub and held its nsec could remove themselves
  from this Authority's roster without the Authority noticing.

authority_proof.description: Identity proof signed by the Authority's OWN npub — the Authority's consent to remove this Operator from the community registry under its signature.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: Nostr npub of the Operator to deregister.

name: authority_deregister_operator
title: Deregister operator
